title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change to be billed to the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustement charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of April, May, and June 1986. The Oil Conservatioon Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from Oil-Conservation to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
